name: Text Easability components
reference_corpus: Reference corpus v1 (easability/REFERENCE_PLAN.md): 9 registers x 1,000 passages of 250-350 words cut by TASA_de's rule (news report, personal narrative, encyclopedia, informational description, research and expert, how-to, opinion/review/advice, persuasion/commercial from FineWeb-2 and TASA_de's sources; fiction 1900-1930 from de-Corp); Coh-Metrix 0.6.0-dev: 0.5.0-py with three definitions of TTLab's duui-coh-metrix 0.6.0 (SYNNP: the words whose head is the noun phrase's head; LSAGN / LSAGNd: the first sentence as 0; German SMTEMP: the Konjunktiv as TMV) and SUBTLEX-DE's full list (README "Version 0.6.0-dev"; snapshot code_20261104_v060dev)
method: PCA on standardized inputs (missing values: reference mean), Varimax rotation; z = standardized inputs @ weights; percentile = share of reference texts with a lower z; at runtime only inputs with missing_documents > 0 may be missing (reference mean), otherwise the components are undefined; one measure of each pair with |r| > .90 removed before the PCA

inputs.measure: Words before main verb of main clause
Dissimilarity of parts of speech between sentences
